entries.title: Bloodborne
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation 4 version with The Old Hunters DLC

emulation.notes: Use official PlayStation hardware. PS4 emulation is not the primary route.

primary.version: Bloodborne with The Old Hunters DLC
primary.why: Bloodborne is a PlayStation 4-only release, and The Old Hunters is the official expansion DLC with new stages, weapons, outfits, and story context. Because there is no official PC, PS5, remaster, or complete higher-fidelity port, the PlayStation 4 version with The Old Hunters installed is the complete official route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PlayStation 4 version with The Old Hunters DLC installed on official PlayStation hardware. PS5 backward compatibility may be used for convenience, but this remains the PS4 release and should not be treated as a PS5 remaster.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official PC or PS5 remaster is logged. Do not substitute unofficial emulation or 60 fps patches for the primary route.
